purpose: Idea exploration with the commander in the room through the pilot's seat: the commander's out-ideas on cockpit rooms, identifiers, manifest and unit JSON, and frontmatter, explored as one scheme until it settles; a dossier follows, then a refactor team

seats.name: cockpit-auditor
seats.reason: evidence of how the rooms, IDs, JSON files and markdown metadata stand today and what depends on current paths
seats.returns: audit with file and line, sizes measured

seats.name: practice-scout
seats.reason: official guidance and specs on frontmatter, YAML validity, manifest and unit patterns, and how the harness itself uses frontmatter

seats.name: option-maker
seats.reason: holds the exploration paper: option space per area, cross-constraints, a leaning, the commander questions; revises as the commander answers

seats.name: adversary
seats.reason: attacks the paper once it settles, before the dossier; held back during exploration so ideas are not killed half-formed

seats.name: assets-scout
seats.reason: added when the commander said flightcrew already holds schema-checking assets on other branches: inventory them by read-only git and judge reuse for a cockpit lint
seats.returns: inventory per branch with reuse verdicts and the best starting point

shape: auditor and scout in parallel; option-maker drafts at once and revises on both reports and on each of the commander's answers relayed by the pilot; assets-scout added mid-flight on the commander's lead; adversary spawned only on the settled paper
outcome: Exploration paper (199 lines, eleven passes, `notepad/ideas-2026-09-20/paper-final.md`) over five areas: rooms, identifiers, manifest and unit JSON, frontmatter, and the schema store the commander added mid-flight. The commander ruled the identifier set in the room (Or046 to Or049). Central result: nothing checks the cockpit's references (24 broken by a three-file rename; about 518 live references in the ruled rename: 231 scriptable, 278 reviewed diffs, 9 verbatim never touched), so a stage A checker in sh and python3 comes first and needs no schema engine; flightcrew's dependency-free Node engine (assets-scout, 93e18c5) is a stage B asset. Adversary: five rounds on the paper (F, G, H, K, L), verdict fit to distil, and one on the dossier (seven findings, all taken). Distilled as Ds006; Rq013 raised. After the dossier the commander settled the rest in direct conversation (Or050 to Or055, De026, De027), recorded in Ds006's closing section. The three Sonnet evidence seats were shut down; option-maker and adversary carried into T011.
lessons: two fast Opus seats cross when the pilot relays findings as they arrive: name the pass under attack by number and freeze the file until the findings are in; four crossings cost three extra passes
holding the adversary until the option space was open worked: it attacked leanings, not half-formed ideas, and by its last round found fault only in arithmetic and scope
the option-maker attacking its own paper while idle found three defects before the adversary did; keep asking for it
every count made from a typed list of rooms was wrong, the option-maker's and the adversary's alike; counts enumerate the filesystem and state their pattern
the pilot misread a commander rule from an idea file and ruled on it (Ds); when the commander's rule is inferred from examples, ask what the rule is before ruling
the pilot ruled against a commander design with a stated rationale (manifest naming); a design the commander gave reasons for goes back as options, not as a pilot ruling
a seat added mid-flight on the commander's lead (assets-scout) paid for itself in one report; read-only git across branches is a Sonnet job
with the commander in the room, verbatim relay of each ruling to every seat at once kept the paper aligned; record each as an order as it is given
